description: This file defines the DateValue class, which provides functionality to convert text strings into date/time serial values or objects based on Excel date formats. It includes methods for parsing date strings, handling different date formats, and integrating with Excel's calendar system.

classes.name: DateValue
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert date strings into Excel date serial numbers or PHP date objects, handling various date formats and regional settings.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string or array of date representations into an Excel date serial number, PHP date/time object, or an error, depending on input and context.

methods.name: t1ToString
methods.description: Converts an array of date components into a normalized date string considering the presence of a year.

methods.name: setUpArray
methods.description: Parses a date string into an array of date components, attempting alternative parsing methods if initial parsing fails.

methods.name: finalResults
methods.description: Generates the final date or error value based on parsed date components and validates the date.
